name: Question 2
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14130082/assets/26520b2b179e8d2bac0b20552d670d8503d734d22bafacb741edb2efce649f4d.png)

What multiplication problem is represented by the model above?
worked_solution:
We have $\frac{2}{5}$ on the left and $\frac{2}{10}$ on the right.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14130082/assets/40183e8f591be9be4dbffc83e45958d184674a4bb83dc83df5a4149cf70b8468.png)

Therefore, the multiplication problem shown is:

$$
\frac{2}{5}\times \frac{1}{2}=\frac{2}{10}
$$
